Body.Content:
We are excited to announce the Public Preview of Azure Sphere (Integrated), a new management interface for Azure Sphere services that is natively integrated with Azure via the Azure Resource Manager.

This Azure Sphere (Integrated) Public Preview comprises:

  • A new REST API for the Azure Sphere Security Services, integrated with Azure Resource Manager
  • Azure Portal and Azure CLI integration
  • Azure Monitor integration
  • Azure RBAC integration

In the blog post, we illustrate the advantages and new features of Azure Sphere (Integrated), and tell you how to take next steps to try it out using either existing or new Azure Sphere devices.

Learn more about the features and enhancements included in this release by visiting What’s new in our customer documentation.

We are excited for you to try this preview out and share your feedback with us via email at azsppgsup@microsoft.com.
